name: Button: Create Note from Opportunity
purpose: Button on the opportunity: calls Create Note { data } in karbon_kontroller with the current user's party as creator and the opportunity's party as regarding and the opportunity as the linked entity (EntityTypeId 13); on failure shows an error dialog and exits -2; on success builds the display party list (related contacts, salesperson, referring party) and opens the new note with Open Activity { Id }.
open_question: EntityTypeId 13 is hard-coded; it probably means Opportunity but the entity type table is not in this file. The create itself is in script 390 (karbon_kontroller), outside this share.

name: Open Note in New Window { Id }
purpose: Opens a note in a new document window on the Note Detail layout: checks the Id parameter is present (else dialog and exit -2), stores it in the selector global, goes to the selected note and puts the cursor in the Subject.
open_question: Disabled step 12 would have opened the note as a card window.

name: Button: Create Note from Party
purpose: Button on the party: calls Create Note { data } in karbon_kontroller with the current user's party as creator and the party as regarding; on failure shows an error dialog and exits -2; on success builds the display party list (the person, related persons and parties already on activities) and opens the new note with Open Activity { Id }.
open_question: The create itself is in script 390 (karbon_kontroller), outside this share.
